business_summary: AS ONE Corporation engages in the sale of research instruments and equipment, nursing and care products, and other scientific instruments in Japan and internationally. The company offers scientific instruments comprising temperature/humidity control and measuring/surveying instruments, as well as universal products used for cooling, heating, mixing, absorption, pressurization, and conveyance; microscopes, glass slides, and tissue culture products for biotechnology; magnifying glasses indispensable for precision work, plus filters, and dispensing devices required for analysis technology; equipment indispensable for research facilities, such as experimental platforms, fume hoods, and pharmaceutical depositories, as well as storage equipment, wagons, laboratory chairs, and conveyance equipment; containers required for storage or preservation of samples, reagents, materials, and others; glass or plastic beakers, flask indispensables, hoses, tubes, and joints; tapes and labels; and timers, packaging machines, tools, office supplies, and other equipment for laboratories. It also provides industrial instruments, such as dehumidifying storage products; equipment for organization, conveyance, etc.; equipment for sterilization/disinfecting and cleaning, including ultrasonic cleaners for washing/drying, detergents, and drying tools; glasses, masks, and gloves; and tools and containers used in clean rooms, as well as dust-proof and anti-static products comprising clean room clothes and mats indispensable. In addition, the company offers hospital/nursing instruments, such as white gowns, masks, and gloves; rack systems for installing in nursing stations; various products, supplies, and equipment required for hospital nursing and care; and sterilizers and sterilization lockers, as well as care cars and beds, and bathing and sanitary products. Further, it engages in warehouse management and cargo handling. The company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: AS ONE Corporation은 일본 및 해외에서 연구 장비 및 장비, 간호 및 관리 제품, 기타 과학 장비 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 온도/습도 제어 및 측정/측량 장비로 구성된 과학 장비뿐만 아니라 냉각, 가열, 혼합, 흡수, 가압 및 운반에 사용되는 범용 제품을 제공합니다. 생명공학을 위한 현미경, 유리 슬라이드, 조직 배양 제품; 정밀작업에 꼭 필요한 돋보기와 분석기술에 필요한 필터, 디스펜싱 장치; 실험대, 흄후드, 의약품 보관소 등 연구시설에 꼭 필요한 장비와 보관장비, 왜건, 실험실 의자, 운반장비; 검체, 시약, 재료 등의 보관이나 보존에 필요한 용기 유리 또는 플라스틱 비커, 플라스크 필수품, 호스, 튜브 및 조인트; 테이프 및 라벨; 타이머, 포장 기계, 도구, 사무용품 및 기타 실험실 장비. 또한 제습 저장 제품과 같은 산업용 장비도 제공합니다. 조직, 운반용 장비
